Sketch made in 182 1, for a public testimonial to commemorate His Majesty's visit to Ireland. Seated on the imperial throne, supported by Hercules and Minerva. The King consummates the union of the sister Kingdoms. The goddess of Wisdom holds in one hand the helm of state, and in the other the olive branch, whilst her favourite hero crushes beneath his feet the hydra of faction. On the lower range Britannia and Hibernia embrace. The golden days of Erin are restored — her bard once more seizes his harp to sing the song of joy, and the genius of history prepares to make a record of the auspicious event.
